survey: A yellow rounded-square music player. Its front face points mostly at the camera. The body is rotated slightly in the picture plane, so its top edge slopes down to the right, and a little tilted, so a thin band of the right and bottom sides shows in a darker orange. On the front face: a large raised white round play button with an orange triangle, centred in the upper half; a row of three small LEDs (red, orange, green) below it; and a small white round button under the middle LED. The LED row slopes down to the right, parallel to the body's top and bottom edges, and the small button sits square under the middle LED, so the layout follows the face. The round parts are near-circles with a little thickness showing on their lower edge. That matches a face seen almost straight on, from the same slight angle that shows the body's bottom side. A white cable leaves the top-right corner through a small plug and loops down behind and beside the body to two earbuds in the lower foreground. The earbuds are seen at different angles, which is natural for loose objects, and each bud's round head matches its own stem direction. There is no ground plane; the object floats.
